catalyst_rows.raw_text: BioVie also recently initiated its ADDRESS-LC Phase 2 long COVID trial and continues to drive patient-focused clinical innovation with the SUNRISE-PD Parkinson's study.

As BioVie continues to advance bezisterim through Phase 2 trials for early Parkinson's disease and long COVID, and plans the next steps in clinical development in our Alzheimer's disease and ascites programs ...

catalyst_rows.indication: Reduction of further decompensation in liver cirrhosis with ascites
catalyst_rows.raw_text: BIV201 (continuous infusion terlipressin), with FDA Fast Track status, is being evaluated and discussed with guidance received from the FDA regarding the design of Phase 3 clinical testing of BIV201 for the reduction of further decompensation in participants with liver cirrhosis and ascites.
